[SWS_DM_01105] Restart OperationCycle during the processing of previous call
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04178
⌈
If the DM is still processing the previous
ara::diag::OperationCycle::
RestartOperationCycle
call of the same
operation cycle
, the DM shall ignore
the current method call.
